zh: 统一 Dragon 浏览器侧栏与推广入口，优化多标签页动画、悬浮菜单、网页输入和外部浏览器打开体验。
完善桌面 Agent、普通及频道对话的统计卡片与回复明细，接入原生计时和本机遥测，区分真实计时、流式速率与观测延迟。
AI 连接支持同一方案配置多个模型，优化模型卡片管理、默认模型选择与全局设置布局。
更新 AI 入门课程内容与中英文资料，完善浏览器和工作区在不同屏幕尺寸下的交互细节。
en: Unified Dragon browser sidebars and promotion entry points, with smoother tabs, floating menus, page input, and external-browser actions.
Improved desktop Agent, personal and channel reply statistics with native timing and local telemetry, clearly separating measured timings, stream rates, and observed latency.
AI connection profiles now support multiple models with improved model cards, default selection, and global settings layout.
Updated the bilingual AI introductory course and refined browser and workspace interactions across screen sizes.
